title: Sofa — one Math Engine, base, cushions, back and arms
description:
A parametric SOFA on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A NODE, A SEGMENT OR A SPACE. Against a wall segment the sofa takes the wall's direction and the BACK faces it; Flip side swaps which way it looks.

WHAT IT BUILDS. Four legs, a base carcass, a full-length back panel, a pair of arms, and seat cushions divided across the clear span between the arms — with back cushions on the same division when asked.

THE CUSHION DIVISION IS ONE BROADCAST. `_span / n` is the pitch and `arange(n) * pitch` every cushion's left edge at once, so a 2-seater and a 6-seater are the same three lines and the same cost. Gap is subtracted from the cushion, not from the pitch, so the run always fills the span exactly.

ARMS ARE OPTIONAL BY WIDTH, not by a checkbox: an arm width of 0 emits an EMPTY operand into the `vcat`, which is the identity — the arms simply are not there, and the cushion span grows to the full length because it is measured from the arm width.

WHY QUADS AND NOT BOXES. Every part is a quad swept z0 → z1, so the kernel that builds an axis-aligned carcass would build a splayed arm or a wedge-shaped chaise with no new code.

THE PLAN IS DERIVED from the same quads with z dropped. Each part is its own 2D row — a grouped outline list is read EVEN-ODD, so cushions drawn in the base's row would void it rather than sit on it.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: 2.00 × 0.90 m, 0.97 m tall, three 0.53 m cushions at a 0.42 m seat height.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. The carcass is rectilinear — an L-shaped sectional or a curved back is a different body, not a different slider. Cushions are blocks, with no crown, piping or compression.

params.name: Sofa maths
params.expr:
_natL = length
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Ln = length * _s
_Dp = depth * _s
_seatH = seatHeight * _s
_backH = backHeight * _s
_backT = backThk * _s
_armW = armWidth * _s
_armH = armHeight * _s
_cusT = cushionThk * _s
_gap = cushionGap * _s
_legH = legHeight * _s
_u0 = 0 - _Ln / 2
_u1 = _Ln / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Dp / 2
_v1 = _Dp / 2
_baseTop = max(_legH + 0.05 * _s, _seatH - _cusT)
_bodyL = _Ln
_bodyW = _Dp
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
# Legs
_lg = 0.06 * _s
_lgi = 0.03 * _s
_L1 = hcat(_u0 + _lgi, _v0 + _lgi, _u0 + _lgi + _lg, _v0 + _lgi, _u0 + _lgi + _lg, _v0 + _lgi + _lg, _u0 + _lgi, _v0 + _lgi + _lg, 0, _legH, 5)
_L2 = hcat(_u1 - _lgi - _lg, _v0 + _lgi, _u1 - _lgi, _v0 + _lgi, _u1 - _lgi, _v0 + _lgi + _lg, _u1 - _lgi - _lg, _v0 + _lgi + _lg, 0, _legH, 5)
_L3 = hcat(_u1 - _lgi - _lg, _v1 - _lgi - _lg, _u1 - _lgi, _v1 - _lgi - _lg, _u1 - _lgi, _v1 - _lgi, _u1 - _lgi - _lg, _v1 - _lgi, 0, _legH, 5)
_L4 = hcat(_u0 + _lgi, _v1 - _lgi - _lg, _u0 + _lgi + _lg, _v1 - _lgi - _lg, _u0 + _lgi + _lg, _v1 - _lgi, _u0 + _lgi, _v1 - _lgi, 0, _legH, 5)
# Base carcass, back panel, arms
_BASE = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1 - _backT, _u0, _v1 - _backT, _legH, _baseTop, 1)
_BACK = hcat(_u0, _v1 - _backT, _u1, _v1 - _backT, _u1, _v1, _u0, _v1, _legH, _legH + _backH, 3)
_hasArm = _armW > 0.001
_A1r = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u0 + _armW, _v0, _u0 + _armW, _v1 - _backT, _u0, _v1 - _backT, _legH, _legH + _armH, 4)
_A2r = hcat(_u1 - _armW, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1 - _backT, _u1 - _armW, _v1 - _backT, _legH, _legH + _armH, 4)
_A1 = _hasArm ? _A1r : zeros(0, 11)
_A2 = _hasArm ? _A2r : zeros(0, 11)
# Seat cushions — a single broadcast across the clear span between the arms
_ns = max(1, round(seats))
_su0 = _u0 + _armW
_su1 = _u1 - _armW
_span = max(0.05 * _s, _su1 - _su0)
_cw = _span / _ns - _gap
_ci = arange(_ns)
_ca = _su0 + _ci * _span / _ns + _gap / 2
_cb = _ca + _cw
_cv0 = fill(_ns, 1, _v0 + 0.02 * _s)
_cv1 = fill(_ns, 1, _v1 - _backT - 0.02 * _s)
_CUS = hcat(_ca, _cv0, _cb, _cv0, _cb, _cv1, _ca, _cv1, fill(_ns,1,_baseTop), fill(_ns,1,_baseTop + _cusT), fill(_ns,1,2))
# Back cushions — the same span, standing against the back panel
_bcT = min(_backT * 0.7, 0.12 * _s)
_bcH = max(0.1 * _s, _legH + _backH - _seatH - 0.06 * _s)
_BCr = hcat(_ca, fill(_ns,1,_v1 - _backT - _bcT), _cb, fill(_ns,1,_v1 - _backT - _bcT), _cb, fill(_ns,1,_v1 - _backT), _ca, fill(_ns,1,_v1 - _backT), fill(_ns,1,_seatH), fill(_ns,1,_seatH + _bcH), fill(_ns,1,2))
_BC = backCushions > 0 ? _BCr : zeros(0, 11)
Q = vcat(_L1, _L2, _L3, _L4, _BASE, _BACK, _A1, _A2, _CUS, _BC)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Base3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Cushions3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Back3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Arms3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 4)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Legs3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 5)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
BasePlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
CushionsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
BackPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 3)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
ArmsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 4)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
overallLength = _Ln
overallDepth = _Dp
overallHeight = _legH + max(_backH, _armH)
seatCount = _ns
seatWidth = _cw
footprint = _Ln * _Dp
